title: Integrated Bioinformatic and Experimental Analyses Identify CNTN6 as a Tumor-Promoting Factor and Prognostic Biomarker in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
snippet: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a highly lethal malignancy, and reliable biomarkers are needed for prognostic stratification and the development of therapeutic strategies. Contactin-6 (CNTN6), a member of the immunoglobulin superfamily of cell-adhesion molecules, has not been fully characterized in HCC. Public datasets were used to evaluateexpression...
